description: This file contains common definitions, macros, and debug configurations for the PTM driver in the UEIP project, specifically for the Lantiq MIPS platform.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Macro for logging error messages based on debug enable mask.

methods.description: Macro for assertions, logs message if condition fails and assertion debug is enabled.
